errors.text: The cited evidence does not directly support L12 ordering, APBE, SISFE, or jagged B2/FCC-boundary embrittlement in AlCoCrFeNi2.1; most evidence concerns different alloys and mechanisms.
The proposed 800°C post-anneal is assumed to reduce L12 order without changing phase-boundary morphology, but this selectivity is unestablished and could confound the falsification experiment.
